title: Sports Illustrated Aug 10 1981 - Mike Schmidt & George Brett MVPs
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Sports Illustrated magazine from August 10, 1981 featuring cover stories on MVPs Mike Schmidt and George Brett. This 1981 edition is written in English and is illustrated, making it a visually engaging read for sports enthusiasts. With a focus on sports and illustrated content, this issue provides a snapshot of the baseball world from that era, highlighting the achievements of these two legendary players.
